hooks.command: if [ -f "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py" ]; then "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready push --hook; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then echo 'loom: publication hook failed (checker runtime unavailable; run loom-python --repair in an agent station); allowing.' >&2; exit 0; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "loom: publication hook failed (installed checker is unavailable at ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py; restart Codex to load the installed plugin version); allowing." >&2; exit 0; fi
